sources.name: Epoch AI
sources.price_label: 输出单价（美元 / 百万 token）
sources.note: 选取 6 个评分与价格可从同一模型页核对的模型，非最新模型全榜。ECI 为跨设置最佳成绩汇总，价格为 Epoch 所列模型价格；不是同一配置的性价比实测。
sources.note_en: Six models with scores and prices verified on the same model page, not a complete latest-model ranking. ECI combines best results across settings; prices are those listed by Epoch, not measured cost effectiveness for one configuration.
